items.question: Does knowing that hidden true nature cause all-knowingness to arise in the knower?
premises: knowing hidden true nature precedes arising
items.inference: Hidden true nature known, all-knowingness arises.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
